response.sql: WITH team_rates AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(1.0 * w / NULLIF(g, 0)) AS average_win_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_win_rate) AS mean_team_rate FROM team_rates) SELECT team_id, average_win_rate, record_count, average_win_rate - mean_team_rate AS difference FROM team_rates CROSS JOIN overall ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10;
